SUBCMD_HELP_DESCRIPTION: Learn how trivia works on this server
HELP_DESCRIPTION: Answer the server's daily trivia questions. Server admins can choose categories and set the daily question limit in the dashboard.
HELP_TIMER_VALUE: Each question has a **20-second default timer**.
HELP_NO_CATEGORIES: No categories are enabled. Ask a server admin to configure Trivia in the dashboard.
HELP_DIFFICULTY_2: **2 — Medium:** Requires some knowledge of the topic.
HELP_DIFFICULTY_4: **4 — Very hard:** Challenging questions about specific details.
HELP_DIFFICULTY_5: **5 — Impossible:** The most difficult questions in the collection.
HELP_WEIGHT_VALUE: A correct answer always earns at least half the question's weight. The other half is a speed bonus based on the time remaining: **round(base points + base points × time remaining / 20)**. Answering immediately earns the full weight; answering at the end of the timer earns half.
HELP_SERVER_ONLY: Trivia is only available inside a server.
PLAY_DAILY_LIMIT: You have reached this server's daily limit of **{0} questions**.
PLAY_ACTIVE_QUESTION: You already have a trivia question open. Answer it or wait for its timer to expire.
PLAY_NO_QUESTIONS: No questions are available for that difficulty in this server's enabled categories.
PLAY_TIMEOUT_DESCRIPTION: You did not answer in time. This question still counts toward today's limit.
PLAY_CORRECT_DESCRIPTION: Great job! You got it right.
PLAY_WRONG_DESCRIPTION: Not quite, but thanks for playing. Try another question!
PUBLIC_CORRECT_DESCRIPTION: Nice work! Give trivia a try with **{0}**!
PUBLIC_WRONG_DESCRIPTION: Not this time, but nice try! Every question is a chance to learn - who's next? Play with **{0}**!
SUBCMD_RANK_DESCRIPTION: See the top trivia players in this server
RANK_EMPTY: No one has earned trivia points yet. Be the first to play with **/trivia play**!
